description: Constructed AR(1) daily if-held return series with genuine positive lag-1 persistence and a small positive daily Sharpe -- the golden fixture for compute_persistence_stats (AC-1) and the AC-2 annualization-flip regression guard (test_annualization_flip_regression reuses this series with sharpe_daily * sqrt(252) substituted).
provenance: Deterministic construction, not captured from any producer. Python: rnd = random.Random(seed=7); shocks = [rnd.uniform(-1.0, 1.0) for _ in range(60)]; r[0] = shocks[0]; r[t] = 0.55 * r[t-1] + shocks[t] for t in 1..59 (AR(1), phi=0.55); daily_returns_pct[t] = (0.06 * r[t] + 0.035) * 100 (scaled to a plausible daily-pct-return magnitude with a modest positive drift, then converted to percent units per the house RETURN_PCT_TO_FRACTION convention). Reproduced independently by the consuming test, which computes expected rho/sharpe via its own reference formula -- this fixture supplies only the raw input series, never a pre-computed expected output (feedback_no_hardcoded_test_values).
